settings.title: Settings
settings.language.desc: Interface language. Auto follows your Windows display language.
settings.theme.desc: Pick a theme or follow Windows.
settings.scanOnStartup.desc: Start scanning as soon as the app opens.
settings.deleteMode.recycle.desc: Safer. Files can be restored, but space is freed only after the bin is emptied.
settings.deleteMode.recycle.descWin: For what you remove by hand (the Disk page, the contents of a target): it can be restored, and frees space once the bin is emptied. Caches are always deleted for good.
settings.deleteMode.permanent.desc: Faster and frees space immediately. Cannot be undone.
settings.deleteMode.permanent.descWin: What you remove by hand is deleted for good and frees space at once. Caches are always deleted for good.
settings.skipRecent.desc: Temporary files and app caches changed more recently than this are left alone: an app may still be using them. Off cleans everything found.
settings.customFolders.desc: Add your own cache folders. Their contents are scanned and cleaned like any other target.
settings.customFolders.refused: This folder is protected and cannot be added.
settings.reset.desc: Restore defaults, including target selection and custom folders.
about.description: A fast, beautiful cache and junk cleaner for Windows. It scans well-known temporary, cache and leftover locations across the system, browsers, developer tools, apps and games, then lets you decide what goes.
about.safety.desc: Only files underneath scanned locations are ever touched. Drive roots, Windows, Program Files and your personal folders are hard-blocked. Recycle Bin mode is on by default.
insight.title: Also on this disk
insight.subtitle: Space JunkCleanup will not touch, but you might want to know about.
insight.copied: Copied “{0}”. Run it in an elevated terminal.
insight.hiberfil.title: Hibernation file
insight.hiberfil.detail: {0} reserved by hiberfil.sys. If you never hibernate, “powercfg /h off” frees it (this also disables Fast Startup).
insight.pagefile.title: Page file
insight.pagefile.detail: {0} used by pagefile.sys. Managed by Windows; resize it only from advanced system settings.
insight.windowsold.title: Previous Windows installation
insight.windowsold.detail: {0} in Windows.old. Remove it from Settings → Storage → Temporary files once you are sure you will not roll back.
insight.recyclebin.title: Recycle Bin
insight.recyclebin.detail: {0} is waiting in the Recycle Bin. Enable the Recycle Bin target to empty it.

disk.title: Disk
disk.subtitle: {0} · {1} used of {2}
disk.subtitle.none: See what fills your disk, folder by folder.
disk.whatsTaking.desc: Largest first. Safe items can go without a second thought; Careful ones only if you know you no longer need them; Keep items are shown so you know where the space is.
risk.Keep.desc: Needed by the system or an app, or your own files. Shown so you know where the space goes; remove it with the app that owns it.
space.caches.name: Caches JunkCleanup can clean
space.caches.desc: Everything on the Targets page that was found on this disk.
space.folder.desc: Data of an app or tool the cleaner does not know. Delete it only if you no longer use that app.
space.personal.desc: Your own files. Shown here, never removed by the app.
space.small.name: Smaller folders
space.kind.cache.name: Cache
space.kind.cache.desc: Downloaded again or rebuilt when needed.
space.kind.backups.name: Backups
space.kind.backups.desc: Copies made before an update or a restore. Remove them once everything works.
space.kind.logs.name: Logs
space.kind.logs.desc: Diagnostic logs. Only useful when reporting a problem.
space.kind.app.name: The app itself
space.kind.app.desc: Program files, runtimes and tools the app needs. Uninstall the app instead.
space.kind.model.name: Model
space.kind.model.desc: Downloaded model weights. Downloaded again the next time they are used.
space.kind.vm.name: Virtual machine
space.kind.vm.desc: A virtual disk with everything installed inside it. Deleting it deletes that machine.
space.kind.image.name: System image
space.kind.image.desc: An emulator system image. The SDK manager downloads it again.
space.kind.game.name: Game
space.kind.game.desc: An installed game. Uninstall it from its launcher.
space.hermes.name: Hermes Agent
space.hermes.desc: The Hermes AI agent (Nous Research). Its caches and pre-restore backups can go; its runtimes, code, history and memories are the agent itself.
space.huggingface.name: Hugging Face models
space.huggingface.desc: Models and datasets downloaded through Hugging Face, one row per model. Each is downloaded again when used.
space.ollama.name: Ollama models
space.ollama.desc: Local language models. Remove the ones you no longer run with “ollama rm”.
space.lmstudio.name: LM Studio models
space.lmstudio.desc: Local language models downloaded by LM Studio.
space.android.images.name: Android system images
space.android.images.desc: Emulator system images from the Android SDK, one per Android version and device type.
space.android.avd.name: Android emulators
space.android.avd.desc: Android virtual devices (AVDs) with their installed apps and data.
space.lost.name: Lost space
space.lost.desc: In use but held by no file: clusters left marked busy by an interrupted copy or a drive pulled out without ejecting. Only a disk check gives them back.
disk.repair.title: Give back {0}?
disk.repair.body: Windows checks {0} and frees the lost clusters (chkdsk /f, as administrator). The drive is unavailable for a few minutes and open files on it are closed; save your work there first. What it finds is saved as FOUND.000\FILE0000.CHK files: pieces of files without names, often from an interrupted copy. Delete them once you know the originals are elsewhere.
disk.pickBand: Click a band to list only its folders
disk.filter.empty: No folder accounts for this space: Windows reports it in use by the system, the file system itself and places an ordinary app cannot read.
disk.removeSafe.title: Remove {0}?
disk.removeSafe.body: Items marked Safe will be removed ({0}): caches and similar files that are rebuilt or downloaded again when needed. Caches on the Targets page are cleaned from there.
space.wsl.name: WSL distributions
space.wsl.desc: Linux distributions under WSL, each a virtual disk. The command lists them; “wsl --unregister NAME” removes one with everything inside.
space.docker.name: Docker
space.docker.desc: Docker Desktop's virtual disk with images, containers and volumes. The command removes unused ones.
space.games.name: Steam games
space.games.desc: Installed games, one row per game. Uninstall them from Steam.
space.programfiles.name: Program Files
space.programfiles.desc: Installed programs. Uninstall them from Settings → Apps.
space.programdata.name: ProgramData
space.programdata.desc: Data shared by programs and Windows: installers' caches, licences, settings.
space.windows.name: Windows
space.windows.desc: The operating system. The command (as administrator) removes superseded update components.
settings.diskWithScan: Measure the disk with every scan
settings.diskWithScan.desc: Scanning also refreshes the Disk page. Turn off to scan only the caches; the Disk page then measures when you open it.
settings.confirmClean.desc: Show how much and how many files will go before anything is removed.
